item.title: Raw Milk: Five Common Claims, Examined
item.description: Humans have been consuming milk from domesticated animals for nearly 10,000 years. Today, raw milk is frequently described as an ancestral health food. Its proponents argue that it retains nutrients, antimicrobial components, and beneficial microorganisms that are damaged by heating. At first glance, that argument is not unreasonable.
